limits: Instrumented timing is excluded from ordinary samples
Inclusive callback CPU can overlap; isolated totals omit overlaps and are not an additive exclusive breakdown
The stored-byte counter at the same terminal boundary is a component measure, not whole-command peak memory
Older absolute profile CPU and final heap values at different boundaries are not causal before/after comparisons

memory_note: Dedicated scope memory.peak includes charged processes and file cache; not PHP heap or a sum of child maximum RSS values.
admission_criteria: Median scope peak decreases by at least 5 percent, at least six of eight paired memory observations improve, elapsed and CPU medians regress no more than 5 percent, candidate elapsed median stays below both Larastan profiles; all 60 native suites, independent graphs and original-size/LRU cohort controls, exact full diagnostics and sealed inputs pass
